The fundamentals of #dogecoin:
 - Cheaper transactions than BTC (1-5 Doge)
 - Faster transactions than BTC (1/3rd the time)
 - More secure with more use (So much use RH and Binance froze)
 - Credible founder
 - Devs releasing updates
 - Kucoin, Webull, RH, and Binance

You'll see in Twitter that people see Dogecoin as the people's crypto and have invested as such.

Dogecoin is not the most technologically advanced, but it is secure, fast enough, and cheap enough to found and sustain this positive emotion behind it. Dogecoin is a quality, secure crypto that has the zeal and enthusiasm of millions behind it, with a great meme representing it.

In raw gains, Dogecoin outpaces BTC, Ethereum, XRP, Cardano, SmartX, and more, bringing in more investors than anyone else. Why? BTC has a cap; XRP has faster transaction speeds, but Dogecoin brings positive emotion with the meme and community. #DogeDay
